description: A working text file on a phone is review-only. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. Open Diffs: on a phone it is in the overflow menu: click the button named "More options", then, in its popover (".chat-overflow-popover"), the button whose accessible name starts with "Diffs" (".overflow-toolbar-action[aria-label=\"Diffs\"]"). The ".diff-viewer-overlay" should be visible. Click ".diff-viewer-overlay .commit-picker-trigger"; in ".git-graph-container" click the ".git-graph-row" containing "Working changes". Click the row titled "only.txt" in ".diff-rethink-mobile-files" and wait for the modified Monaco editor to show "after". There is no button named "Edit" in the viewer. Evaluate that ".diff-viewer-rethink .editor.modified textarea.inputarea" has readOnly === true and tabIndex === -1. Tap the "after" line in the modified editor; the Comment dialog opens with quoted text "after". Close it without submitting. Call "working-file-content" and confirm it still returns "after\n".
